description: Parse the declaratively-defined routing structure. Auto-detects: React Navigation, Expo Router, Next.js App Router, Next.js Pages Router, React Router v6/v7, Remix. Returns navigators + screens + a formatted tree, and names which framework was detected when nothing parses. KNOWN LIMIT: models route DEFINITIONS only — transitions made imperatively (navigate(), router.push()) are not edges, so the graph can under-report reachability (a warning flags this when detected). Pass the PROJECT ROOT directory, not a component file.

rootPath.description: Path to the root navigation/routing file or directory containing the project

name: get_navigation_structure
